section_1_tools.title: MyClaw 3.0 - Build an always-on AI team with shared memory
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: As a PM, you will often need to coordinate multiple workstreams. This tool helps you see how shared-memory AI teams work together, giving you ideas for automating your own workflows.

section_1_tools.title: Airbot - The AI chief of staff that texts you first
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: PMs live by task management and staying on top of priorities. Testing proactive AI assistants gives you a firsthand look at conversational UX patterns you might build into your own products.

section_1_tools.title: Hiring Right Now - Which startups would hire you?
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: Since you are actively hunting for APM roles as a fresher, this tool helps you discover active startups that are hiring right now so you can target your applications.

section_1_tools.title: Falcon by Vybe - Falcon analyzes your competitors for free, then gets to work
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: Competitor analysis is a core PM skill for writing PRDs and strategy docs. This tool automates that research, showing you how AI can speed up market analysis.

section_2_ai_news.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Watching how major product teams handle feature merges, user limits, and scaling tradeoffs is a great real-world case study for your PM interviews.

section_2_ai_news.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Understanding market sentiment and financial pressures in the AI industry helps you talk smartly about business models and unit economics during company interviews.

section_2_ai_news.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: As an aspiring PM working with AI features, understanding current user experience pain points and product limitations will help you scope realistic MVPs.

section_2_ai_news.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Data privacy is a massive challenge for modern product builders. Seeing how early-stage startups tackle security gives you talking points on handling user trust.

section_3_india_news.title: PhonePe resumes IPO process; targets listing in Feb-March at $12-15B valuation
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Fintech giants driving toward massive public listings indicate where major product scaling and hiring budgets will flow in the Indian ecosystem.

section_3_india_news.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to exit after over 11 years
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Leadership shifts at India's top e-commerce players often trigger strategy resets and organizational re-alignments that affect product team roadmaps.

section_3_india_news.title: [Update] Anthropic Rolls Out Claude Duet In India After US Launch
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Global AI giants expanding their product suites directly into India means new tools to experiment with and local market adoption trends to track.

section_3_india_news.title: Vegapay Bags $10 Mn To Scale Credit Line On UPI Infrastructure
section_3_india_news.why_it_matters: Watching how early-stage fintech startups secure funding and build niche features on top of UPI provides great inspiration for consumer product design.
